title: Cubic binary-field solver backend
statement: Define a binary-field linear solver backend whose solver is the row-elimination solver and whose work count is the cubic solver work count. For every finite, decidable-equality, encodable coordinate type and every finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$, if the equations have a satisfying assignment, the solver's output satisfies every equation in the list.
hypotheses_covered: Equality on the coordinate type is decidable
The input is a finite list of linear equations
